head_commit.message:
feat: port config types, endpoints, exec env, conversation manager, and git info

- Expand Config.kt with full field set from Rust Config struct
- Add remaining config types: UriBasedFileOpener, History, OTEL, Notifications,
  Tui, Notice, SandboxWorkspaceWrite, ShellEnvironmentPolicy
- Wire Chat/Responses endpoints to real SSE stream parsers (replacing TODOs)
- Rewrite StreamingClient with SseStreamType-based dispatch
- Add missing ApiError variants: Unauthorized, RateLimited, ServerError, HttpError
- Port ExecEnv with shell environment policy enforcement and wildcard matching
- Port ConversationManager with conversation lifecycle management
- Add CodexError variants: ConversationNotFound, NotImplemented, SessionConfiguredNotFirstEvent
- Port GitInfo with repo root detection, git info collection, recent commits,
  and default branch name resolution

head_commit.message:
feat: port config types, endpoints, exec env, conversation manager, and git info

- Expand Config.kt with full field set from Rust Config struct
- Add remaining config types: UriBasedFileOpener, History, OTEL, Notifications,
  Tui, Notice, SandboxWorkspaceWrite, ShellEnvironmentPolicy
- Wire Chat/Responses endpoints to real SSE stream parsers (replacing TODOs)
- Rewrite StreamingClient with SseStreamType-based dispatch
- Add missing ApiError variants: Unauthorized, RateLimited, ServerError, HttpError
- Port ExecEnv with shell environment policy enforcement and wildcard matching
- Port ConversationManager with conversation lifecycle management
- Add CodexError variants: ConversationNotFound, NotImplemented, SessionConfiguredNotFirstEvent
- Port GitInfo with repo root detection, git info collection, recent commits,
  and default branch name resolution
